finding: Book-detail tag pills are effectively invisible in dark mode — they look like loading skeletons.
evidence: Computed text rgb(30,41,59) on bg rgba(99,102,241,0.12) over body rgb(30,30,46) → measured contrast ≈1.1:1 (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1). Visible in 02_book_summary_above_fold.png as 4 dim rectangles to the right of the cover where tag labels should be readable.
suggested_fix: Add a dark variant on the tag chip: text token slate-100/200 and bg indigo-500/25 (or use the same .badge token used elsewhere). Verify the chip in both themes hits ≥4.5:1.

finding: Primary CTA "Read" on BookSummaryPage routes to section 1, which is the Copyright/front-matter page — not the first real chapter.
evidence: Probed `a[href*=/sections/]` → href = /books/1/sections/1 (section 1 = "Copyright"). Library's "Continue reading" banner shows the same: "You were reading Understanding Michael Porter, Copyright". Same anti-value for any book whose section 1 is front-matter.
suggested_fix: When no read-position exists, default Read to the first section whose `section_type` is `chapter` or `introduction` (not `copyright`/`acknowledgments`/`about_author`). When a read-position exists, only persist positions where the user actually scrolled or played — front-matter visited for <Ns shouldn't count.

finding: Two h1 elements on the page: banner says "Book Companion", main says "Understanding Michael Porter".
evidence: Snapshot 02_book_summary.snapshot.md lines 25 (banner h1 "Book Companion") and 37 (main h1 "Understanding Michael Porter"). Same pattern on /books/1/sections/3 (banner h1 = book title, but main has no h1 — different problem).
suggested_fix: Demote the banner heading to a non-h1 element (`role="img"` for a wordmark, or a `<span class="sr-only">` link). Reserve h1 for the page's primary subject (book title on /books/:id, section title on /books/:id/sections/:id).

finding: Overview tab is a single sentence telling the user to use other tabs — wastes the default landing surface.
evidence: 02_book_summary_above_fold.png: Overview tabpanel content is one paragraph: "Use the Summary tab to read or generate a book-level summary, or the Sections tab to browse chapters." After cover/title hero, the entire fold below the tab strip is empty.
suggested_fix: Replace with an at-a-glance dashboard: last-read section + Continue, top 3-5 concepts (link to /concepts), most recent annotations, eval pass-rate badge, summary preset in use. Each tile should answer a user decision (resume vs start over, what's hot, what to clean up).

finding: Sections list surfaces "Chars" (raw character count) and "Compression" (%) columns that don't anchor any user decision.
evidence: 03_book_sections_tab.png: columns # | Title | Type | Chars | Summary | Compression. Values like 23,107 / ~20% are model/system metrics. User can't decide "read this vs that" from char count or compression ratio.
suggested_fix: Replace Chars with "Read time" (≈ chars/1100 words/min). Move Compression into a hover detail or remove from the list view entirely. Keep Type as a leading icon (chapter/introduction/glossary) rather than a literal column to reduce noise.

finding: Front-matter (Copyright, Acknowledgments), chapters, and back-matter (About the Author, Notes, Glossary) are interleaved in one flat list with no grouping.
evidence: 03_book_sections_tab.png rows 1-2 are copyright/acknowledgments, rows 3-13 are introduction+chapters, rows 14-17 are FAQ/glossary/notes/about_author. Visually identical rows.
suggested_fix: Group rows under "Front matter" / "Chapters" / "Back matter" subheaders (collapsed by default for front/back), or filter front/back behind a "Show all sections" toggle. Ensures the chapter list is the dominant scannable region.

finding: Section rows have no visible affordance — no hover state, no row-level Listen/Read/Edit action.
evidence: 03_book_sections_tab.png: rows are flat text on flat bg, no chevron, no hover style visible in the static capture, no inline action buttons. To open a section the user has to guess that the title (or row?) is clickable.
suggested_fix: Make the row a button-card with hover bg, cursor-pointer, and inline icons (▶ Listen, 📖 Read, ⋯ More) revealed on hover. Add a chevron at the end.

finding: Book Summary tab is one continuous wall of markdown with no in-page anchors, sticky outline, or jump-to-section affordance.
evidence: 08_book_summary_tab_full.png: full-page screenshot shows a single uninterrupted column of bullets and headings spanning many viewport heights. No TOC, no sticky sub-nav, no "back to top".
suggested_fix: Render a sticky right-hand outline (h2/h3 from the markdown) that scrolls with the document. Add anchor IDs and a back-to-top FAB. Optionally wrap long sub-sections in an "Expand" disclosure for progressive disclosure (J3).

finding: Summary tab has no metadata strip — preset used, generated-at, eval status, default-summary-id are not surfaced where the user is reading the summary.
evidence: 08_book_summary_tab_full.png: summary content begins immediately under the tab strip — no "Generated 2 days ago · practitioner_bullets · 14/16 evals passed · Regenerate" header.
suggested_fix: Add a metadata strip above the markdown: preset chip, generated-at relative time, eval pass-rate badge, "Regenerate" / "Switch preset" / "Compare versions" actions.

finding: Audio empty state offers "Generate audio" with no preview of cost, time, engine choice, or what content it will read.
evidence: 04_book_audio_tab.png: text "No audio yet for this book." + button "Generate audio". No copy explaining: which engine (Web Speech vs Kokoro), how long ~338MB / N minutes synthesis takes, whether it covers content or summaries, whether Kokoro requires the optional install.
suggested_fix: Empty state should show: a 2-3 line description ("We'll synthesize all 12 chapter summaries with Kokoro / fall back to Web Speech"), engine selection chip, estimated synthesis time (chars / engine throughput), and what it produces (summaries vs content). Add a "What's the difference?" link explaining engines.

finding: Section toolbar packs 7 disparate controls (←, Original/Summary toggle, →, Listen, ☰, ⚙) into one row with no separators, mixing navigation, mode-switch, action, and chrome.
evidence: 05_section_detail.snapshot.md lines 37-57: in one flex row: prev arrow, Original|Summary segmented control, next arrow, Listen, ☰, settings cog. No visual grouping; all live at the same elevation.
suggested_fix: Split into 3 groups with subtle dividers: (1) prev/next + section picker breadcrumb dropdown — nav, (2) Original|Summary segmented — mode, (3) Listen + Reader settings — actions. The section drawer ☰ should be either a left-edge rail toggle or relocated to the breadcrumb row.

finding: Prev/Next arrow buttons are single-character glyph-only targets that fall under the 24×24 minimum.
evidence: 05_section_detail.snapshot.md refs e38/e42: button content "←" / "→" with no padding visible in screenshot 05_section_detail_above_fold.png (icons crammed beside the segmented control).
suggested_fix: Increase hit area to ≥40×40 px, add aria-label "Previous section" / "Next section" (currently they're literally text "←"), and add a tooltip showing the destination section title.

finding: Three icon-only chrome buttons (☰, ⚙, ⋯) provide no visible label or hint; their function is unrecoverable without trial.
evidence: 05 snapshot e44 "☰" (no aria-label visible in snapshot), e46 "Reader settings" (good), e54 "More actions" on book page (good). The ☰ is the worst — no aria-label exposed.
suggested_fix: Add aria-label and tooltip to ☰ (likely "Sections drawer" or similar). Pair the icon with a text label on hover for first-time discoverability, or expand to icon+label at the larger viewport (sidebar has space).

finding: "Limited controls" amber badge tells the user something is wrong but doesn't say WHAT is limited or HOW to upgrade.
evidence: 07_audio_playing.png + DOM: span data-testid=limited-controls says only "Limited controls". Adjacent chip "Web Speech" hints at the cause but no link/tooltip explains the diff vs Kokoro or how to enable.
suggested_fix: Make the badge a button or include a tooltip: "Web Speech can't seek or scrub. Install the Kokoro engine for full controls →" linking to /settings or a docs popover.

finding: "0:00 / 0:00" timestamp is shown beside the sentence counter, but Web Speech can't compute duration — the field is dead pixels.
evidence: 07_audio_playing.png + DOM span: "0:00 / 0:00" rendered next to "sentence 1 of 17". Web Speech API does not expose total duration prior to synthesis.
suggested_fix: Hide the time display when engine is Web Speech, or replace it with a qualitative chip ("≈4 min" estimated from chars/wpm). The sentence counter alone is more useful than a fake clock.

finding: No keyboard shortcut hints surfaced for the audio player (space, ←/→ skip).
evidence: 07_audio_playing.png: player chrome has only icons, no "Space" hint or shortcut row. No help overlay reachable from /books/* per snapshots.
suggested_fix: Add tooltips with shortcut hints ("Play (Space)", "Previous sentence (←)"). Add a `?` keyboard-shortcuts overlay reachable from the player and section detail.

finding: Library view-mode toggle uses three glyphs (▦, ☰, ▤) without text labels or tooltips; the third glyph in particular is opaque.
evidence: 01_library.snapshot.md refs e45/e46/e47: button "▦", "☰", "▤" — no aria-label rendered in the snapshot, no inline tooltip.
suggested_fix: Replace with labelled icon buttons (Tabler/Lucide grid / list / compact icons) and aria-label "Grid view" / "List view" / "Compact view". Persist selection in localStorage and indicate active state with bg-token, not just color.

finding: Each book card has a checkbox in the top-right but no visible explanation of what bulk actions are enabled by selecting books.
evidence: 01_library.snapshot.md refs e59/e70/e83: each book link contains a checkbox child with no nearby "Select N" toolbar or hint copy.
suggested_fix: Hide the checkbox until the user enters bulk-edit mode (toolbar button "Select"). When active, show a sticky action bar with the available bulk verbs (Delete, Re-summarize, Export, Tag).

finding: Continue-reading banner names "Copyright" as the last position — same as the Read CTA bug — but here it's even more visible because it's the first thing users see.
evidence: 01_library.png: banner reads "You were reading Understanding Michael Porter, Copyright". Snapshot e30/e31. Implies the user spent time on Copyright; in reality the read-position tracker likely fires on first render of section 1.
suggested_fix: Don't persist a read-position until the user has scrolled past N% of the section or remained for >Ns. Skip front-matter section_types when picking "first chapter" defaults.

finding: Primary button (Read, Continue, Generate audio, Upload) appears consistent in shape but contrast on the muted blue against the dark slate is borderline for the white text.
evidence: Visible in 02 (Read), 04 (Generate audio), 01 (Upload) — same pale lavender/blue fill (looks like indigo-300/400) with white text. Sample contrast indigo-300 (#a5b4fc) on white text ≈3.0:1 — fails AA for normal text but passes for large text.
suggested_fix: Use a deeper indigo (indigo-500/600) for primary fill in dark mode or switch to white-bg + indigo-text for the secondary variant. Confirm ≥4.5:1 with the actual button-text size.

finding: Audio-player engine chip ("Web Speech") uses light-mode-only styling (bg-slate-100 text-slate-700) and is not adapted for dark theme.
evidence: DOM: `class="... bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"` with no `dark:` variant. Visible in 07_audio_playing.png as a light-on-light pill on the dark-mode-aware playbar.
suggested_fix: Add `dark:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-100` to `.bc-engine-chip` (or use the design-token chip class already used for the "All N sections summarized" badge).

finding: Section rows in the Sections tab lack hover/focus affordance and inline actions — same finding as 03/C3 but applies to the component class.
evidence: 03_book_sections_tab.png. Same evidence as the per-screen finding.
suggested_fix: See section-row fix above; treat as a single component change.

finding: Library → Book Summary fits comfortably in the daily-flow click budget (1 click).
evidence: 1 click from /, 0 keystrokes, 0 modal interrupts. Threshold ≤6 — passes.
suggested_fix: No action — journey is efficient. Issue is at the destination (see findings above).

finding: BookSummaryPage has competing primary affordances (Read, ⋯, tabs Overview/Summary/Sections/Audio/Annotations) with no clear single primary CTA per user intent.
evidence: 02_book_summary_above_fold.png: Read button is filled-primary, tab strip below is the actual workhorse. User's intent ("read summary") is split across Read CTA, Overview tab, Summary tab. Tab-strip is the right control but Read CTA pulls focus to a different journey (back to original text).
suggested_fix: Demote "Read" to a secondary action (text+icon), elevate Summary tab to default. Or rename Read → "Read original" and add a primary "Read summary" / "Listen" pair in the same row to make the choice explicit.

finding: Audio playback does not surface progress through the section beyond "sentence 1 of 17".
evidence: 07_audio_playing.png: only sentence counter shown; no progress bar, no estimated remaining time, no chapter-level progress.
suggested_fix: Add a thin sentence-progress bar (17 segments, completed shaded). On Kokoro, replace 0:00/0:00 with real time. On Web Speech, use chars-elapsed estimate (rounded to 0:30s).

finding: Closing the audio player (✕) is not paired with persisting position; if the user navigates away, where they were in playback is invisible until they return.
evidence: DOM contains data-testid play-pause, no `aria-current` or persistent indicator on the section row in the Sections tab. ttsPlayer store likely persists internally per CLAUDE.md (#23), but the UI doesn't echo "Resume from sentence 5" anywhere outside the player.
suggested_fix: After ✕ or page transition, show a docked "Resume listening — Introduction · sentence 5 of 17" bar at the bottom of the next page. Mirrors the "Continue reading" banner pattern.
